name: application-multi-select-combobox
title: Multi-Select Combobox
description: Searchable dropdown that returns multiple checked values from a predefined option list, rendered as removable chips inside the input.
useWhen: Users need to pick several values from a known, searchable option list (e.g. assignees, tags from a fixed taxonomy).
The option list is long enough that typing to filter is faster than scrolling a multi-select list.
Selected values should stay visible as removable chips while more can still be added.
avoidWhen: Only one value can be selected at a time — use the single-select Combobox instead.
Users need to enter arbitrary free-text values not from a predefined list — use Tag Input instead.
The option list is short (under ~8 items) — a multi-select checkbox list is simpler and needs no typing.
responsiveBehavior: The chip input wraps selected chips onto multiple lines as needed; the listbox is absolutely positioned and full-width relative to the input.
accessibility: The input carries role='combobox' with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the listbox.
The listbox carries role='listbox' and aria-multiselectable='true'; each option is role='option' with aria-selected reflecting its checked state.
Each chip's remove button has an aria-label naming the specific value being removed.
Selection is conveyed via a checkmark icon and background tint together, not color alone.

variants.title: Multi-select combobox
variants.description: Open listbox with two values already selected as chips and checkmarked in the option list, on a light surface.
accessibility: Options use onMouseDown preventDefault so clicking a checked option toggles it off without the input blurring first.

variants.title: Multi-select combobox (Dark)
variants.description: Open listbox with two values already selected as chips, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Chip and listbox colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
